episodes.synopsis: Tetsuro and the others get attacked by unknown assailants while Juzo is out getting the data from the memory medium he recovered from Rosa. Mary runs into her long-missing brother, Victor, during her escape from the attackers...
episodes.title: Turning Point

episodes.synopsis: Mary begins to question her memories with Victor. Maybe she never really understood him at all. In order to confirm things with her own eyes, she heads to the Kyusei Pit with Juzo, who happened to be going the same way. There, Lefty greets them.
episodes.title: Client

episodes.synopsis: As Juzo faces Victor as Mary is shocked by how much he has changed. The war and what he saw there seems to have turned him into some kind of monster. If someone has to stop his maniacal rampage... At the very least, it should be her.
episodes.title: A Place to Call Home

episodes.synopsis: Avi Cobo has once again appeared and now he's taken Mary hostage. Juzo watches as the two men clash. Each and every one of them... They all just keep getting in the way of his job. Now, he's not going to just stand back and let a girl suffer.
episodes.title: Engineer

episodes.synopsis: Juzo and the others try to get back into their normal lives as things have seemingly resolved with Spitzbergen. A mysterious man watches from the shadows as Juzo goes downstairs to get his maintenance done. The time has finally come...
episodes.title: Noble Rot

episodes.synopsis: A woman name Emma appears at Inui's office and asks him to find her husband. The mysterious Edmund seems to be looking for Juzo as well. Juzo is taken aback when they meet. It seems, after all these years, he's come to settle an old score.
episodes.title: Traces of Crime

episodes.synopsis: Tetsuro struggles with his task to take control of Juzo. The appearance Edmund pulls up Juzo's past and forces Tetsuro to face even more of the absurdity in this world. Unsure of himself and his own past, he turns Juzo for direction.
episodes.title: Scar

episodes.synopsis: Juzo, pretending to be controlled, runs away while leaving Tetsuro's body behind with Professor Wachowski. The two of them have a discussion about Berühren once more. Tetsuro struggles with his decisions, both from the past and in the present.
episodes.title: I'm Dreaming

episodes.synopsis: Juzo continues to hold Shimazu and Kunugi back while Tetsuro finishes things up. During the struggle, new players appear at the scene and Juzo finds out that Kunugi may not be on Spitzbergen's side, after all.
episodes.title: Degeneration

episodes.synopsis: Without a Hands, Juzo is fighting a losing fight. Even so, he doesn't budge from his ideals. Even though Tetsuro knows Juzo will get mad at him, Tetsuro uses Harmony on him once again. There, Tetsuro discovers the reason for Juzo's decision.
episodes.title: Imprisoning Binds

episodes.synopsis: While Tetsuro speaks with Juzo, things get out of hand outside. The EMS, Security Bureau, and Berühren rush to the scene to control the situation. There, Pepper whispers to Seven that she wants everything destroyed. As Pepper's gun, Seven complies.
episodes.title: Trigger Again

episodes.synopsis: Pepper wakes up at the Reconstruction Agency hospital without her Hands device. Juzo meets with her to finish things up after taking a job from Seven. Yet again, Berühren has managed to slip away and Juzo continues his days with Tetsuro.
episodes.title: Earnest Desire
